concerns.text: FR-003 mandates rejection of datasets with >10% missing values. T007.2 generates invalid data for testing, but there is no task explicitly implementing the 'reject' logic path in the main ingestion/preprocessing flow (e.g., raising DataRejectionError in the primary pipeline) that T007.2 is meant to trigger. T015 implements the check, but the orchestration to ensure the rejection path is exercised in the main flow is missing.

FR-001 requires the system to download and parse datasets based on user-provided accession IDs or keywords. Tasks T009.1.1 and T009.1.2 implement the internal `fetch` and `parse` methods, but there is no task to implement the user-facing CLI argument parsing or API entry point that accepts these IDs/keywords and invokes the methods. The system cannot satisfy FR-001 without this entry point.

FR-004 requires training Random Forest models. Task T022 implements this logic but is marked incomplete `[ ]`. Additionally, T022 depends on `model_result.schema.yaml` (T004.2), which is also marked incomplete `[ ]` in Phase 2. The core requirement FR-004 is currently unmet due to missing tasks.

FR-010 requires Leave-One-Dataset-Out (LODO) validation using distinct datasets. Task T030 relies on T009.3 to generate synthetic 'virtual datasets'. However, there is no task ensuring these synthetic datasets are truly independent (distinct sources/stress vectors) rather than just subsets of the same data, which is a strict requirement for LODO. The plan mentions this, but the task to enforce the independence logic is missing.

T042 (Quickstart Execution) depends on T046 (Orchestration/`main.py`), but T046 is listed as a dependency of T042 in the execution order. This circular dependency prevents the verification of the full pipeline (SC-005) because the entry point (T046) is required to run the test (T042), yet the test is required to unblock the entry point. A task to break this cycle or re-order dependencies is missing.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires pinned random seeds. Task T047 adds a `--seed` argument, but there is no task explicitly ensuring that the `generate_synthetic_data` function (T007) and all downstream model training functions (T022, T023) actually consume and apply this seed to the underlying libraries (numpy, sklearn) to guarantee reproducibility. The mechanism is missing.
